name: Himitsu no Houkago 2 ~Coach to Oshiego no Abunai Dousei Seikatsu~
original_name: ひ・み・つ・の放課後2～コーチと教え子のアブナイ同棲生活～
source:
Main character works as a teacher and supervises skating club. One female student gives a lot of promise, and he dreams of winning at Olympics with her.
One day unknown girl comes to his house and demands to keep promise and teach her playing fugue. Teacher does not recollect the promise, but lets her stay at the house.
At the same time president's daughter threatens to accuse him of harassment unless he spends a night with her. A one time thing escalates into longing passion, and soon two other girls start to demand equal attention.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-april-2006-tenshitsuki-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角担任教师并监督滑冰俱乐部。一名女学生给了他很大的希望，他梦想着和她一起在奥运会上获胜。
有一天，一位不知名的女孩来到他家，要求遵守诺言并教她演奏赋格曲。老师不记得自己的承诺，但让她留在家里。
与此同时，总统的女儿威胁要指控他骚扰，除非他与她共度一夜。一次性的事情升级为渴望的激情，很快另外两个女孩开始要求同样的关注。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-april-2006-tenshitsuki-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
